description: Which structural differences appear, disappear or persist as scale, topology, memory, coupling and horizon change, at five observation resolutions.
question: At which observation resolutions (node, local, meso, macro, global) is each structural difference systematic, and does that depend on scale, topology, memory, coupling or horizon?
measured: for each variant vs the reference C: DETECTED / EQUIVALENT / UNRESOLVED at each resolution, with the noise replicate C~ as false-positive control
does_not_show: That a difference is necessary or fundamental: one-factor-at-a-time around one reference, not a factorial design; other untested factors may change the picture.
